# External dependencies

This directory is a local workspace for third-party backbone and benchmark repositories.
It is intentionally excluded from Git, except for this guide.

Clone each required project into its documented path (for example, `external/SwinIR`
or `external/SAMed`). Do not commit their source, datasets, checkpoints, or generated
outputs. Record the upstream URL and revision used for a paper result in your notes.

See `experiments/cross_task_replacement_README.md` for the cross-task workflow.
